scripts.db:generate: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.development node -r dotenv/config node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.development node -r dotenv/config node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.development node -r dotenv/config node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:studio: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.development node -r dotenv/config node_modules/prisma/build/index.js studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.development node -r dotenv/config node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db seed --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:sqlite:migrate: node scripts/generate-sqlite-schema.cjs && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma-desktop/schema.prisma
